title: Accessing Tokyo Station — Tokyo Station City
claims: From Narita Airport, Tokyo Station is about 60 minutes by Narita Express or about 90 minutes by Express Airport Narita.
The airport limousine bus from Narita to the Tokyo/Nihombashi Station area takes about 80-110 minutes.
From Haneda Airport, take the Tokyo Monorail to Hamamatsucho, then about 35 minutes by Keihin-Tohoku Line or Yamanote Line to Tokyo Station.
The airport limousine bus from Haneda to Tokyo Station Yaesu South Exit takes about 40 minutes.
Tokyo Station is served by JR conventional lines and Shinkansen, the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, and the Tozai Line at Otemachi.
Tokyo Station can be reached by car via the Inner Circular Route Yaesu Exit or Gofukubashi Exit.
